beginner.summary: For analysts, researchers and developers who are new to R. Covers installing R and RStudio, vectors, lists and data frames, functions and control flow, importing data with readr, tidy data with tidyr, wrangling with dplyr, strings and dates, visualisation with ggplot2, debugging, Quarto reports and a reproducible report capstone.
prerequisites: Comfortable with spreadsheets or another programming language at a basic level
Can install software and manage files and folders on Windows, macOS or Linux
Has a laptop with permission to install R, RStudio or Positron and Quarto
outcomes: Write and debug R scripts using vectors, lists, data frames and functions
Wrangle and reshape data with dplyr, tidyr, stringr and lubridate
Create clear charts with ggplot2 and export them
Produce a reproducible Quarto report from an organised RStudio project

advanced.summary: For experienced R developers who need fast, reliable and secure R in production. Covers profiling, memory, data.table, Arrow and DuckDB, parallelism, Rcpp, metaprogramming, S7 and vctrs, targets pipelines, production and asynchronous Shiny, plumber APIs, Docker, CI/CD, scheduled jobs, Posit Connect deployment, CRAN release, Python integration, supply-chain security and a production service capstone.
prerequisites: Has built an R package or Shiny app with tests and version control
Understands functions, environments and S3 classes
Knows Docker and Git concepts at a working level
outcomes: Profile and optimise R code for time and memory
Build, containerise and deploy R APIs, apps and scheduled jobs
Automate testing, checks and releases in CI
Secure dependencies, secrets and inputs in production R
